results.title: AEW Revolution 2026
results.overview: The 2026 Revolution was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on March 15, 2026, at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Adam Page in a Texas Death Match for the AEW World Championship.

results.title: The SAS
results.overview: On February 20th, 2016, a college student's friend goes missing. Through phone recordings, we recall the event that led up to his disappearance.

results.title: Agito: Superpower War
results.original_title: アギトー超能力戦争ー
results.overview: In a world where people awaken to supernatural powers, one ordinary police officer Makoto Hikawa stands against this chaos.

results.title: ICU
results.overview: Set against the tense backdrop of a hospital's intensive care unit, the story follows a chaotic day marked by a brutal attack and a sudden family emergency that entangles enemies and loved ones alike. As critical decisions unfold under immense pressure, hidden truths, fear, and fate collide.

results.title: Miracle: The Boys of '80
results.overview: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.

results.title: The Monster She Married
results.overview: Groomed since she was a teen, a woman confronts the dark truth about her husband, the man she once trusted as her pediatrician. When another one of his patients is murdered just days before testifying against him, she must break her silence.

results.title: Einar Schleef - No Germany Did I Find
results.original_title: Einar Schleef - Ich habe kein Deutschland gefunden
results.overview: With his monumental productions, Einar Schleef pushed theatre to the outer reaches, confounded expectations in East and West alike, grappled with GDR origins and the BRD present. A universal artist emerges from the archive: “I’m not human, I’m dynamite”.

results.title: Dharmayuddhaya 2
results.overview: A murder investigation is reopened after 8 years, making life far more complicated for a man related to the case and his family.

results.title: Living Book
results.overview: After losing his father, Roma lost his faith in goodness and became brash and rebellious. Together with a timid elementary school student, Vitya, they sneak into the house of a mysterious old man, where they find magical books with animated characters. Through carelessness, the boys unleash an evil sorcerer. To save his friend and restore everything to its rightful place, Roma must do the impossible: believe in himself again.

results.title: On Our Own
results.overview: Growing up without her parents, who had gone to work in the West, Flavia became a tough but distant teenager. The routine that keeps her safe and emotionally isolated is disrupted when two young children who have run away from home seek shelter with her.

results.title: The Stars Between Us
results.overview: Seven years ago, Kim made a connection with a stranger during an eclipse event. Now a fledgling news reporter, Kim returns to Illinois for this year's eclipse, unaware that their paths may cross again.

results.title: Rao Bahadur
results.overview: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

results.title: The Samca File
results.overview: 15 years after 3 bizarre murders shook a small provincial town, a team of documentary filmmakers revisit the case, confronting theories of a satanic cult, local conspiracies, and the terrifying possibility of a killer still on the loose.

results.title: Dilan 1997
results.overview: Dilan is an ITB student who returned from Cuba in March 1997. In the midst of the heated political situation leading up to the Reformation.

results.title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
results.overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

results.title: The Couple Across the Street
results.overview: When a family seeks refuge with their "doomsday prepper" neighbors during a community lockdown, they start to suspect their hosts have dangerous intentions, until a shocking twist reveals the real threat was far closer than they ever imagined.

results.title: Don't Be Shy!
results.overview: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.
